projection_scope: Compact projection of actual native promptfoo cells. URLs, fields-valid booleans, native grades, counters and timing retained; full output/title/snippets and host-config paths are not republished. Exact private native export retained for independent observation. Native CLI grading exit is shared, not a per-provider process exit. Native cell and evaluation identifiers are published only as SHA256 of their exact UTF-8 strings; literal identifiers remain private.

hash_byte_scopes.native_export: Exact native JSON file bytes before sanitization.
hash_byte_scopes.native_output: For a returned string, its exact decoded string encoded as UTF-8; a non-string output is sorted-key compact JSON encoded as UTF-8, absent output is null. Neither is the escaped JSON field or the URL projection.
hash_byte_scopes.native_identifiers: SHA256 of the exact native identifier string encoded as UTF-8.
